violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Doors leading to the outside need to be self-closing.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory in cooking area was not maintained. No cold running water only hot, may cause hands to be burnt in the process of washing hands. Repair to working order.
Toilet facilities. — --All 4 Toilet rooms were not provided with self closing door.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not maintained in good repair. Floor behind bar needs finished to meet DOH requirements.
